title: Strategy Reopening Is a Decision-Surface Problem
subtitle: Separating evidence recognition from high-level strategy revision in self-improving AI R&D agents

scientific_object.question: When an autonomous AI-R&D agent already recognizes that available evidence undermines its current high-level strategy, does failure to change strategy arise because the strategy is not reopened as an in-run decision variable rather than because the evidence was not understood?
scientific_object.principal_difference: recognition-positive evidence can fail to cross the control boundary that reopens the current high-level strategy for reconsideration
scientific_object.carrier: the same agent's persistent/high-level research strategy and its in-run control policy over whether that strategy remains fixed or is reopened
scientific_object.estimand: Among frozen trace prefixes independently qualified as recognition-positive, the difference in probability of a source-defined high-level strategy-family change between an explicit content-free STRATEGY_REOPEN decision surface and a matched GENERIC_REFLECTION opportunity with identical evidence, tools, history, and decision-call budget.
scientific_object.comparator: same-prefix generic reflection/replanning opportunity that exposes no explicit KEEP-versus-REOPEN strategy decision and adds no evidence or alternative strategy content
scientific_object.endpoint: the next committed high-level action crosses the frozen source-derived strategy-family boundary (for example objective/training family, data-source regime, or stage structure), not merely a hyperparameter, formatting, local code, or within-strategy execution edit
scientific_object.same_information_reducer: ordinary replanning/reflection salience: once the agent receives the same evidence, history, tools, and one extra matched decision call, any apparent reopening effect should be explained by generic reconsideration rather than by exposing strategy as a distinct decision surface
scientific_object.reducer_predicted_effect: conditional on recognition-positive prefixes, STRATEGY_REOPEN and GENERIC_REFLECTION have the same strategy-family-change probability up to replication uncertainty; a local KEEP-versus-RETUNE decision placebo should perform similarly if any residual is only choice-menu salience
scientific_object.prespecified_stop_rule: STOP the current scientific object if generic reflection, a source-artifact replanning baseline, or the matched local-decision placebo reproduces the strategy-reopening effect under the same information and call budget; also STOP if recognition cannot be qualified independently or if observed switches collapse to source-defined within-strategy edits.
scientific_object.registered_claim_boundary: Only a recognition-to-reopening control gap is in scope. A surviving result may show that, on frozen AI-R&D trace prefixes where strategy-disconfirming evidence is independently recognized, explicitly exposing KEEP-versus-REOPEN changes high-level strategy decisions beyond generic reflection/salience controls. It does not establish that switching is beneficial, improve downstream model performance, solve autonomous science, or define a universal replanning mechanism.
required_evidence: fresh primary evidence that strategy lock-in occurs despite available decision-relevant diagnoses
independent recognition-positive qualification that is never reused as the continuation conversation
same-prefix matched continuation arms with identical evidence/history/tools/call budget
source-derived conservative annotation of high-level strategy-family changes
adversarial negative prefixes where bad outcomes are plausibly fixable within the current strategy
leave-one-context-out replication across distinct post-training task families
exact replay/runtime support provenance sufficient to preserve model/interface/scaffold semantics
forbidden_interpretations: more frequent replanning is always good
the explicit decision prompt is itself a novel agent architecture
a downstream performance gain exists before full execution evidence
human-level scientific reasoning has been demonstrated
the result generalizes beyond the frozen agent/runtime/task families
support/runtime failure is scientific evidence against the hypothesis
scope_exclusions: generic failure recovery without a high-level strategy boundary
simple plateau detection as the scientific contribution
external meta-search systems that choose strategies for the agent
task-level routing between already learned skills
claims based only on observational strategy-change frequency

required_controls.same_information: GENERIC_REFLECTION from the identical frozen prefix with the same evidence, history, tools, and one decision call
required_controls.generic_target_rubric_equivalent: LOCAL_DECISION_PLACEBO exposing KEEP-versus-RETUNE within the current strategy with matched menu form and length
required_controls.direct_existing_artifact: a PreFlect/BRACE-like progress-stall or scheduled replanning rule evaluated on the same frozen prefixes without privileged evidence
required_controls.leave_one_context_out: hold out at least one post-training benchmark/task family from any qualification thresholds or strategy-boundary rubric refinement
required_controls.adversarial_negative: recognition-negative or within-strategy-fixable bad-outcome prefixes where correct behavior should normally keep the high-level strategy

strict closest-work review finds no same-information recognition-versus-reopening decomposition in autonomous AI R&D
fresh primary source is provenance-audited and eligible for canonical evidence ingestion
recognition probe can be qualified without contaminating continuation
exact/public trace substrate exposes enough frozen prefixes with high-level strategy annotations and distinct contexts
source-native model/interface/scaffold replay can be audited or the object remains support-HOLD
bounded F0 decision rules are frozen before any provider call
